title: lbw-kit config v0.13.0
description: A bot's widgets for LBW.kit.setup(config). Generated from the checker (kit/setup-check.js); `npm run check:config` is the full check.

version.description: Your own version of the config (not read).

prefix.description: The tags' prefix: [[prefix:widget …]]. A plain word.

langs.description: The languages, lower-case codes ("es", "ca"): every text may be { "es": …, "ca": … }.

timeZone.description: The client's time zone, as Europe/Madrid.

maxPerMessage.description: Widgets drawn per message at most (3).

links.description: The allow-list: https origins ending in "/", "tel:", "mailto:".

labels.description: Your own widgets' words, by language.

quietMs.description: ms of quiet before a reply is drawn.

reveal.description: false: don't scroll the chat to the start of a tall reply.

motion.description: false: no animations in this bot.

base.description: An https address ending in "/", under "links".

screen.description: Screen mode: the chat as an app, one screen at a time. The newest widget is the screen, the messages before its turn fold behind "View conversation", a header shows the steps and a bar mirrors the primary action.

header.description: The app header: a title and the steps.

steps.description: 2–8 steps, [id, label]: the id is a lower-case word (a tag's step=id or step=2, or a widget's "step").

progress.description: true: a bar and "Step 2 of 4" instead of the steps by name.

bar.description: false: no bottom bar (the primary action mirrored while it is out of view).

history.description: "collapse" (earlier messages fold behind "View conversation", the default) or "keep" (they stay).

bleed.description: true: the current screen drops its card and bubble, fills the column, its short text reads as a heading and its buttons as full-width rows.

replies.description: Named replies: { name: [label, sentence] or [label, sentence, { field: value }] }.

widgets.description: The widgets by tag name (lower-case letters, digits and _).

byLang.description: The same value by language: { "en": …, "es": … }, one per code in "langs" (texts or lists only).

text.description: A text, or the same text by language.

reply.description: A reply: a name in "replies", or [label, sentence] or [label, sentence, { field: value }] (the visitor sends the sentence; the fields are saved in Landbot).

action.description: An action: a name in "actions", or an object with one of tel, wa, link, reply, mail and a "label".

use.description: The name of an action in "actions" this one starts from.

tel.description: A phone number to call (needs "tel:" in "links").

link.description: A URL under an entry of "links" (a calc's links may hold {placeholders}).

reply.description: [label, sentence] or [label, sentence, { field: value }]: the visitor sends the sentence.

danger.description: A destructive action (never the primary one).

text.description: The text this action carries, where a widget fills it ({text}).

links.description: Buttons: actions (names in "actions" or written out).

after.description: true: the sign after the amount.

space.description: A space between the amount and the sign.

params.description: Typed values the tag carries ({name} in any text): { "plazas": { "type": "int", "min": 0, "max": 99 } }.

param.description: A typed value from the tag.
